text: The portrait lesson text box is 4:5 (width:height, 0.80:1), replacing the roughly 3:5 in ui.lesson.card.orientation-2026-10-05. It spans about 89% of the viewport width and 51.5-52% of its height (390x844: ~348x435 pt; 430x932: ~383x480; 375x667: ~334x418). Landscape stays about 5:3. Proposed container: width 100%, aspect-ratio 4/5, max-height calc(100dvh - 380px), overflow-y auto.
rationale: Owner specified the portrait text box ratio and dimensions
